name: @aura/predictive
description: AURA Predictive Engineering Platform — deterministic, ML-ready risk prediction. Five pure engines (Risk, Prediction, Confidence, Simulation, Impact) turn a sealed evidence schema (git churn, governance reports, knowledge graph, mission/diagnosis/automation history) into predicted hotspots, regressions, upcoming architecture risks and suggested preventive actions. No ML, no randomness, no fake data — every number is a documented function of real signals.
